scripts.sync-ui:tradsphere: mkdir -p apps/tradsphere/ui_dist && rm -rf apps/tradsphere/ui_dist/assets apps/tradsphere/ui_dist/index.html && cp -R frontend/apps/tradsphere/dist/* apps/tradsphere/ui_dist/
scripts.sync-ui:all: bash -lc 'for name in tradsphere home shiftzy; do src="frontend/apps/$name/dist"; dst="apps/$name/ui_dist"; if [ ! -d "$src" ] || [ -z "$(ls -A "$src" 2>/dev/null)" ]; then echo "==> skip $name (no dist)"; continue; fi; echo "==> sync $name"; mkdir -p "$dst"; rm -rf "$dst/assets" "$dst/index.html"; cp -R "$src"/* "$dst"/ || exit 1; done'
